title: Model 2
heading: Model *two*
sub: A page reserved for the second model. It will carry that model's question, method, parameters and checks once the work is ready to publish.

blocks.body: No model on this page has been built or run yet. When it is, this section will state the question, the assumptions behind it and where each assumption comes from.
The formulation, the solver and its settings will appear here together, so that every result can be checked against the method that produced it.
Every parameter will be listed with its value, unit and source, and marked as measured, taken from the literature, or fitted.
Predictions will be shown next to the data they are compared with, together with the error, how strongly the result depends on key parameters, and the range in which the model can be trusted.
The code, input files, software versions and the steps to reproduce each figure will be linked from here.
